title: Union Parliament: Functioning, Decline, and Representation

scenes.text: Can a parliament representing deep diversity survive intense political conflict?
scenes.narration: Imagine running a huge school where students constantly debate every single rule. Can a national parliament with so many diverse voices actually govern India, or does intense rivalry cause it to decline?

scenes.text: Parliament functions like cricket, needing active batting and disciplined bowling to succeed.
scenes.narration: Here is an everyday analogy to make this click. Think of Parliament like a cricket match: the ruling government bats to make laws, while the opposition must bowl disciplined deliveries to keep them accountable.

scenes.heading: Parliamentary vs Presidential System
scenes.narration: Our Constitution makers chose a parliamentary system so Ministers remain accountable to lawmakers every day. Unlike presidential systems, a collegiate cabinet shares power and gives India's diverse communities a genuine voice.

scenes.name: Morris Jones
scenes.idea: Early parliament faced apprehensions over diversity and Nehru's concealed dictatorship.
scenes.narration: British scholar Morris Jones noted early worries about Indian democracy due to vast social cleavages. He observed that Nehru's towering presence created a concealed dictatorship, leaving the early legislature with a very weak opposition.

scenes.heading: Phases of Parliamentary Evolution

events.what: Defections, Emergency trial, and regional rise

scenes.narration: Parliament evolved through distinct chapters. After initial stability under Nehru, political defections and the nineteen-seventy Emergency tested democracy, leading into the nineteen-nineties when fractured coalitions saw the steepest decline in functioning.

scenes.heading: Parliamentary Ethics
scenes.narration: Here is the golden rule of parliamentary ethics: the opposition must have its say, but the government gets its way. Unfortunately, frequent walkouts and adversarial battles disrupt this delicate balance.

items: Parliament ensures day-to-day accountability and plural representation
Institutional decline accelerated during contentious coalition eras
Urgent electoral reforms are vital to revive democracy
scenes.narration: Remember these three essentials. First, parliamentary democracy secures daily accountability and diverse representation. Second, institutional effectiveness sharply declined from the nineteen-nineties. Finally, sweeping electoral reforms are the mother of all remedies.
